methods.limits: Entered single-direction approximation; no spatial response or cylinder scattering. Fig. 18 theory is for cos beta=0.1; other beta choices are scenario transfers, not evaluated scattering solutions.

methods.basis: §4.2 p. 28 does not recommend it for formal preliminary loads. Not generalized.

referenceConventions.quantity: Selected-band external acoustic pressure, not structural or internal response
referenceConventions.equation8Note: Printed Eq. 8 has + log Deltaf. Implemented linear-power bandwidth conversion uses 10 log Deltaf, dimensionally consistent with Eq. 4.

digitization.method: Manual sparse readings of faired curves from locally rendered official PDF, not a fit to scattered measurements
digitization.uncertainty: Estimated reading uncertainty only: 1–1.5 dB densities/directivity and 12–15% apparent locations; not independently certified.

interpolation.density: log x / dB; exact segment power-law integral, or selected center-density times bandwidth
interpolation.directivity: linear angle and log Strouhal, no angle extrapolation

digitization.tailPolicy: Missing density tails omitted and warned; position outside curve fails. Nearest St directivity extension is explicitly selectable. No hidden curve normalization.
